title: NBT Labs audit question bank
description: One bank file = one layer. Layers compose onto base. Every bank validates against this schema. Freeze a bank once it is in production and bump bank_version to change it: scores are only comparable within an instrument_version (see scoring/scoring.v1.json#versioning).

bank_id.description: Unique, stable. Also the prefix of every question id in this file.

layer.description: base is always asked. model/industry are selected by firmographic answers. The rest are conditional layers.

applies_when.description: ALL conditions must hold for this bank to be served. Empty/absent = always.

reweight.description: Multipliers applied to BASE dimension weights when this layer is active. Lets construction make quote_to_cash heavier without rewriting the base bank. Normalized after application.

notes.description: Internal. Never shown to a respondent.

i18n.description: Both languages are mandatory everywhere. An FR-missing bank fails validation by design: Charter s.52/s.57 means the French version ships at the same time, not later.

field.description: A question id, or a firmographic key such as firmo.employees.

id.description: bank_id.dimension_short.qNN — e.g. base.q2c.q01. Stable forever. Never reuse an id for a different question.

oneOf.description: Unscored. Routes layers and feeds the cost model.

type.description: single = one item-specific option (the default and preferred form). multi = checklist, each item scored or informational. number = open numeric, banded to a level. text = free text, NEVER in the quiz instrument (costs ~12.5pp completion; Liu & Wronski 2018).

help.description: Optional one-line clarifier. Counts against total word budget — use sparingly.

instruments.description: quiz = the public self-serve scorecard. audit = the live 1-2h session. A question in both must have identical wording and identical position in the shared ordered core, or quiz-vs-audit score movement is an artefact.

weight.description: Within-dimension weight. 0 = informational only, excluded from the dimension score.

options.description: Required for single/multi. Item-specific, concretely described states — never agree/disagree and never a bare 1-5 (Saris et al. 2010; Tourangeau et al. 2000).

reveals.description: Cost-model input keys this question populates. Must exist in scoring/scoring.v1.json#cost_model.inputs.

routes.description: Firmographic questions only: which layer bank_ids each answer activates.

show_when.description: ALL must hold for this question to be served.

artifact_probe.description: Audit instrument only. The thing the consultant asks to SEE, to convert a self-reported claim into an observed fact (Shingo evidence stance). This is the structural reason the live audit beats the quiz and self-report correlates ~.29 with reality (Zell & Krizan 2014).

benchmark_ref.description: Key in scoring/benchmarks.v1.json. Only set it where a defensible benchmark exists — absent means 'we make the client supply the number', which is deliberate, not an omission.

level.description: Maturity level this described state corresponds to. See scoring/scoring.v1.json#ladder. Levels 4-5 require MEASUREMENT and REVIEW, not more software (CMMI: only 8 of 32 practice areas reach L4).

na.description: 'We don't do this at all' — substantive information, excluded from the dimension score. NOT a don't-know escape hatch: 'nobody here knows' is level 1, written as a scored option (Krosnick et al. 2002).

informational.description: Unscored; used for routing or the cost model.

flag.description: Raises a named finding in the report regardless of the dimension score.

reveals.description: Cost-model inputs this specific answer sets.

allow_unknown.description: 'I don't know' on a count is itself a maturity signal and scores at unknown_level, not as missing data.

bands.description: Ordered, non-overlapping. First matching band wins.
